name: Tass (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tass: a crowned white and blue shield with a yellow chalice, with red and green mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tass arms with crown and mantling
